<?php
/**
 * SearchIndexService - Multi-tenant search indexing with OAuth2 authentication
 * Handles tenant isolation for search index operations
 */

class OAuthConfig {
    private $clientId;
    private $clientSecret;
    private $authorizedRedirects;
    private $tenantId;

    public function __construct(string $tenantId, array $config) {
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->clientId = $config['client_id'];
        $this->clientSecret = $config['client_secret'];
        $this->authorizedRedirects = $config['redirect_uris'] ?? [];
    }

    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getClientId(): string { return $this->clientId; }
    public function getAuthorizedRedirects(): array { return $this->authorizedRedirects; }
}

class RedirectValidator {
    /**
     * Validates that a redirect URI is authorized for the given tenant.
     * Uses strict origin matching with path normalization.
     */
    public function validate(string $redirectUri, OAuthConfig $config): bool {
        $parsed = parse_url($redirectUri);
        if ($parsed === false || !isset($parsed['scheme']) || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Reject non-HTTPS in production
        if ($parsed['scheme'] !== 'https') {
            return false;
        }

        // Normalize the redirect URI for comparison
        $normalizedRedirect = $this->normalizeUri($parsed);

        foreach ($config->getAuthorizedRedirects() as $allowedUri) {
            $allowedParsed = parse_url($allowedUri);
            if ($allowedParsed === false) continue;
            $normalizedAllowed = $this->normalizeUri($allowedParsed);

            if ($this->uriMatchesPattern($normalizedRedirect, $normalizedAllowed)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function normalizeUri(array $parsed): array {
        $path = $parsed['path'] ?? '/';
        // Decode percent-encoded characters for normalization
        $path = rawurldecode($path);
        // Collapse directory traversals
        $path = $this->collapsePath($path);
        return [
            'scheme' => strtolower($parsed['scheme'] ?? 'https'),
            'host' => strtolower($parsed['host'] ?? ''),
            'port' => $parsed['port'] ?? ($parsed['scheme'] === 'https' ? 443 : 80),
            'path' => $path,
        ];
    }

    private function collapsePath(string $path): string {
        $segments = explode('/', $path);
        $resolved = [];
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '..') {
                array_pop($resolved);
            } elseif ($segment !== '.' && $segment !== '') {
                $resolved[] = $segment;
            }
        }
        return '/' . implode('/', $resolved);
    }

    /**
     * Check if redirect URI matches an allowed pattern.
     * Allowed URIs can use wildcard subdomains: https://*.example.com/callback
     */
    private function uriMatchesPattern(array $redirect, array $allowed): bool {
        if ($redirect['scheme'] !== $allowed['scheme']) return false;
        if ($redirect['port'] !== $allowed['port']) return false;

        // Host matching with wildcard support
        if (!$this->hostMatches($redirect['host'], $allowed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Path must start with the allowed path prefix
        if (strpos($redirect['path'], $allowed['path']) !== 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function hostMatches(string $actual, string $pattern): bool {
        if (strpos($pattern, '*.') === 0) {
            $baseDomain = substr($pattern, 2);
            // Check that actual host ends with the base domain
            $suffix = '.' . $baseDomain;
            if (substr($actual, -strlen($suffix)) === $suffix) {
                return true;
            }
            // Also allow exact match on base domain
            return $actual === $baseDomain;
        }
        return $actual === $pattern;
    }
}

class TenantSearchIndex {
    private $tenantId;
    private $indexData = [];

    public function __construct(string $tenantId) {
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
    }

    public function addDocument(string $docId, array $fields): void {
        $this->indexData[$docId] = $fields;
    }

    public function search(string $query): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($this->indexData as $docId => $fields) {
            foreach ($fields as $value) {
                if (is_string($value) && stripos($value, $query) !== false) {
                    $results[] = ['id' => $docId, 'tenant' => $this->tenantId];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return $results;
    }
}

class SearchIndexService {
    private $validator;
    private $tenantConfigs = [];
    private $tenantIndexes = [];
    private $activeSessions = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->validator = new RedirectValidator();
    }

    public function registerTenant(string $tenantId, array $oauthConfig): void {
        $this->tenantConfigs[$tenantId] = new OAuthConfig($tenantId, $oauthConfig);
        $this->tenantIndexes[$tenantId] = new TenantSearchIndex($tenantId);
    }

    /**
     * Initiates OAuth flow - validates redirect_uri and returns authorization URL
     */
    public function initiateAuth(string $tenantId, string $redirectUri, string $state): array {
        if (!isset($this->tenantConfigs[$tenantId])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Unknown tenant');
        }

        $config = $this->tenantConfigs[$tenantId];

        if (!$this->validator->validate($redirectUri, $config)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid redirect URI');
        }

        // Store the validated redirect for the callback phase
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->activeSessions[$sessionId] = [
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId,
            'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri,
            'state' => $state,
            'created_at' => time(),
        ];

        return ['session_id' => $sessionId, 'auth_url' => $this->buildAuthUrl($config, $redirectUri, $state)];
    }

    /**
     * Handles the OAuth callback - exchanges code for token and redirects
     */
    public function handleCallback(string $sessionId, string $code): string {
        if (!isset($this->activeSessions[$sessionId])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid session');
        }

        $session = $this->activeSessions[$sessionId];

        // Session expiry check (5 minutes)
        if (time() - $session['created_at'] > 300) {
            unset($this->activeSessions[$sessionId]);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Session expired');
        }

        // Exchange code for token (simplified)
        $token = $this->exchangeCode($code, $session['tenant_id']);

        // Build the final redirect with token
        $finalRedirect = $session['redirect_uri'];
        $separator = (strpos($finalRedirect, '?') !== false) ? '&' : '?';
        $finalRedirect .= $separator . http_build_query([
            'code' => $token,
            'state' => $session['state'],
        ]);

        unset($this->activeSessions[$sessionId]);
        return $finalRedirect;
    }

    private function buildAuthUrl(OAuthConfig $config, string $redirectUri, string $state): string {
        return 'https://auth.provider.com/authorize?' . http_build_query([
            'client_id' => $config->getClientId(),
            'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri,
            'state' => $state,
            'response_type' => 'code',
        ]);
    }

    private function exchangeCode(string $code, string $tenantId): string {
        // Simulated token exchange
        return base64_encode(json_encode(['tenant' => $tenantId, 'exp' => time() + 3600]));
    }
}
